name: sota_fa3_varlen_docmask
env: ATTN_BACKEND=fa3 COMPILE_MODE=max-autotune-no-cudagraphs STOP_MODE=time TIME_BUDGET=300 DOC_MASK=1 DOC_MASK_IMPL=varlen
levers: fa3 varlen intra-document attention masking via cu_seqlens
mechanism: Document structure is handed to the fa3 kernel as cu_seqlens rather than materialized as a boolean mask, so cross-document attention blocks are skipped outright. Quality AND throughput improve together (+40..78 steps).
note: Supersedes sota_swin4 (0.95058). Also beats the reconciled 10-seed baseline 0.939797 by -0.003493. Prior sdpa/flex doc-masking was sub-gate ONLY because the fa3->sdpa backend penalty (+0.012) cancelled the doc-mask benefit (-0.011); running it on fa3 removes the penalty.
funnel_stage: n=10 COMPLETE (1->3->6->10); satisfies this scope's min_seeds=10 adoption requirement
